ticket: #190 (spec #181): the optional extra round for early-sign areas
note: Round named after the ticket so parallel tickets of spec #181 do not take the same r<n>. Savar could not be reached: the implementer shipped option A of each look (most consistent with DESIGN.md, D-088 and the r189 report patterns) and lists the others so Savar can swap.
invariants: Copy: no performance claims (DESIGN.md). The child is told the questions help us see more clearly and that skipping is fine; the parent is told the report is made again with the answers
Real components: TakeTest (test.tsx with test-extra.tsx) and ReportCard (report.tsx), driven through the real test attempt module on its in-memory store
No database or network: a temporary harness page and API under /dev-r190 (not committed) answered the test API from the in-memory store; the dev server ran on port 3190 with no .env.local

looks.decision: How the test offers the extra round, after the last main question

options.name: Message screen like the halfway break
options.bet: The split-desk message pane (kicker 'Main questions done', large title, lead) with 'Yes, 8 more' and 'No, thanks' as two buttons; the colour field on the right
options.benefit: One tap either way; reuses the break screen the child has already seen, so it reads as a pause, not a question
options.cost: Two buttons of different weight: yes is the dark button

options.name: Choice rows with Next, like 'Did anyone help?'
options.bet: Two full-width radio rows and Next, the help screen's pattern
options.benefit: Neutral weight for yes and no
options.cost: One more tap; looks like another test question
options.risk: A child may think the choice is marked

options.name: Full colour field
options.bet: The end screen's colour field with 'Great work, Asha! Want 8 more?'
options.cost: Reads like the end of the test, so 'No, thanks' feels like quitting and 'Yes' like starting over; 'Great work' praises a result the child has not seen
options.risk: Mixed message with the end screen

looks.decision: Where the report offers a skipped round again

options.name: Card under the area table
options.bet: A soft grey card with the tangerine square right under the 'Early sign' labels it checks; 'Start the extra questions' (after a stop: 'Continue the extra questions')
options.benefit: Next to the results it makes more certain; the r189 card styles

options.name: First in the context row
options.bet: Beside the FSA note, where the reliability note sits
options.cost: Asks for more questions before the parent has read any area result
options.risk: Competes with the reliability note when both show

options.name: In the next-step row
options.cost: Competes with starting the books; far from the early-sign labels
options.risk: Reads like a step before buying

stop: Added after the verifier's finding (Savar's decision, reversible): each round question has 'Stop here', a ghost button at the far end of the row from Next (test-round-stop.png, tablet: test-round-stop-tablet.png). During the test it goes on to 'Did anyone help?' and the result leaves the round out; a child who left part way comes back to 'Welcome back' with 'Keep going' and 'Stop here' (test-round-return.png). From the report it ends with '3 of 8 done' (report-round-stopped.png), and the report offers the rest. Rejected: 'Stop here' right beside Next (first try of this round: easy to press by mistake).
email: No second email (the simpler path): the report row is built again in place, and the parent reads it in the account.
